canonical.title: Weekend at La Rei Natura — Serralunga d'Alba

sources.title: La Rei Natura — Il Boscareto Resort
sources.claim: La Rei Natura sits inside Il Boscareto Resort at Via Roddino 21, Serralunga d'Alba

sources.title: Mammoliti earns third Michelin star — The Upcoming
sources.claim: Only Italian restaurant promoted to 3 stars in the 2026 Michelin guide; promotion landed November 2025

sources.title: Il Boscareto Resort — Trip.com
sources.claim: Il Boscareto Resort is roughly a 25-minute walk from the Castle of Serralunga

sources.title: Castello di Serralunga d'Alba — tickets & info
sources.claim: May-Oct opens Thu 14:30-18:30 and Fri-Mon plus holidays 10:30-13:30 / 14:30-18:30; guided-tour only (45 min)

sources.title: Fontanafredda — The Barolo of Serralunga tour
sources.claim: €45 per person for a 1h30 guided cellar visit plus tasting of three Barolos, English & Italian, advance booking required

sources.title: Borgo Sant'Anna — Monforte d'Alba
sources.claim: Pasquale Laera's Michelin-starred Borgo Sant'Anna in Monforte d'Alba

sources.title: Belvedere di La Morra — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Belvedere di La Morra is the classic sunset panorama over the Barolo vineyards

sources.title: Sentiero del Barolo — Visit La Morra
sources.claim: 11.5 km Sentiero del Barolo trailhead in La Morra

sources.title: Castello di Guarene — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Relais & Châteaux 18th-century castle hotel, 15 guestrooms, frescoes, indoor pool carved into rock

sources.title: Fondazione DIG421 — Cherasco
sources.claim: Cherasco's Thursday-evening AI talks; only IT-flavoured venue in the 30 km radius

sources.title: Taxi Barolo / Barolo Wine Tours — transport
sources.claim: Local buses effectively stop after dinner; private luxury car/driver transfers cover the after-dinner return

sources.title: LangheInTaxi (NCC Bellero)
sources.claim: Covers Alba, Barolo, Barbaresco, Bra and surrounding villages; phone +39 335 5862890; hours 06:00–23:00

sources.title: Il Boscareto Resort & Spa
sources.claim: 49 rooms and suites, indoor pool, La Sovrana Spa, 62-space covered parking with EV charging, Via Roddino 21

sources.title: Palás Cerequio — Barolo Cru Relais
sources.claim: 9-suite Barolo-cru relais owned by Michele Chiarlo, restored noble palace between La Morra and Barolo

sources.title: RÉVA Resort — Monforte d'Alba
sources.claim: 12 rooms in a former farm; FRE restaurant has held a Michelin star five years running

sources.title: Casa di Langa — Cerretto Langhe
sources.claim: 39-room eco-sustainable resort on 42 ha of UNESCO-protected Langhe countryside; Michelin Green certification

sources.title: Hotel Castello di Sinio
sources.claim: 9 suites and 5 rooms in a restored 12th-century castle in Sinio, between Barolo and Barbaresco zones

sources.title: Villaggio Narrante — Fontanafredda
sources.claim: Fontanafredda's hospitality cluster: Cascina Galarej, Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore, Foresteria delle Vigne

sources.title: WiMu — Wine Museum, Castello Falletti di Barolo
sources.claim: Multi-floor experiential wine museum inside Castello Falletti, designed by François Confino

sources.title: Serralunga d'Alba Castle — Barolo & Castles Foundation
sources.claim: Rare intact 14th-century donjon-type tower-keep, one of the best-preserved medieval military buildings in Piedmont

sources.title: Castello di Grinzane Cavour
sources.claim: UNESCO World Heritage castle, former residence of Camillo Benso Conte di Cavour, houses Museo delle Langhe and Enoteca Regionale
